venues.name: Live Oak Bank Pavilion

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office at Live Oak Bank Pavilion will open on show days at 10:00 a.m. The box office will also be open on Fridays from 10 am to 4 pm only when a show is going on sale to the general public. If no shows are going on sale on a particular Friday, the box office will remain closed. For more information on our box office hours, send us a message on our social pages. To purchase tickets, please visit us at www.livenation.com. We look forward to seeing you at our next show at Live Oak Bank Pavilion.

venues.parkingDetail: There is no on site parking at Live Oak Bank Pavilion, however, there are several publicly owned parking decks nearby as well as metered street parking. If you are getting a ride to the show, there is a drop off point that is located at the top of Harnett St. and Front St.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Accessible seating is available on a first come first served basis. Accessible tickets can be purchased online via www.livenation.com. Look for the accessible logo on the Find Tickets page to view all available accessible seats. Live Oak Bank Pavilion meets all ADA requirements regarding accessibility, concessions, restrooms and viewing area for the show. For more information, visit Liveoakbankpav.com/accessibility
